digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler rich-text codec and adapters
propositions: Cloud descriptions and comments must encode Markdown as structured ADF; DC descriptions and comments must render Markdown as native Jira wiki markup, without echo loops or content erosion.

A bidirectional asymmetric codec design routes Cloud through Markdown-aware ADF functions (marklas optional extra) and DC through a segmenting wiki renderer (pandoc-backed with fallback), both behind an echo-safety layer using ADR-0026 baselines and change-gated rich_sha.

DC renderer must handle timeout, subprocess lifecycle, and GPL/SBOM obligations; missing pandoc or pathological input falls back without data loss; Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) survive via origin-gating in normalize_outbound.

Concurrent edits (baseline/local/remote three-way comparison) must be flagged instead of silently overwritten; unchanged reconciliation passes must add zero committed-state entries; second passes must perform no body update.
Comments are append-only with persistent local-key→Jira-comment-ID map; comment creation routes through the same rich-text codec as descriptions for consistency.

Live DC acceptance requires rendered-HTML verification via expand=renderedFields through a Dockerized Jira DC harness; all six child stories (swan, lion, hamadryas, shrew, mutt, graywolf) must close before epic closes.
